body:
## Pull request overview This pull request adds integration tests to verify the fix for issue #2967, where ACL groups containing deleted or unknown users would break connectivity for valid users. The fix ensures that the policy manager is updated immediately when a user is deleted, preventing stale policy state from breaking connectivity when groups contain references to non-existent users. **Changes:** - Added `DeleteUser` method to the integration test control interface and implementation in `hsic` - Updated `DeleteUser` in state management to return a change signal and trigger policy manager updates - Added 5 comprehensive integration tests covering various scenarios of unknown/deleted users in ACL groups - Added unit test to verify `DeleteUser` returns proper change signal ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | integration/hsic/hsic.go | Added `DeleteUser` method to enable user deletion in integration tests | | integration/control.go | Added `DeleteUser` method to `ControlServer` interface | | integration/acl_test.go | Added 5 integration tests covering unknown/deleted user scenarios in ACL groups | | hscontrol/state/state.go | Modified `DeleteUser` to return change signal and update policy manager immediately | | hscontrol/grpcv1_test.go | Added unit test to verify `DeleteUser` returns proper change signal | | hscontrol/grpcv1.go | Updated to use change signal returned from `DeleteUser` instead of manually creating one | | .github/workflows/test-integration.yaml | Added new tests to CI workflow |
